question: research-plan.md item C
frozen_by: Claude, before any 7-year or 3-seed number for this question exists

what_is_being_measured.intervention: mask the three first-3F derived columns (asof_rel_first3f_avg, asof_rel_first3f_best, asof_pace_balance_avg) during TRAINING so the fitted model sees the supply it will actually be served
what_is_being_measured.mask_unit: row, keyed on (race_id, horse_id) - NOT race-atomic. Measured: the all-missing-race rate is flat at 7-9% in every year (debut races) while the row rate jumps 11% -> 41.7% in 2026, so the 2026 shortfall is within-race partial missingness.
what_is_being_measured.mask_rule: raise every year's row-level missing rate for those three columns to the 2026 observed rate, masking only rows that currently carry values; a year already at or above it is untouched

arms.control: trained on the matrix as-is  (what production does today)
arms.candidate: trained on the masked matrix (091's move, applied to this block)

what_is_being_measured.no_serving_side_change: The mask is a training device. At serving time the missingness is natural; nothing is masked in production. Adopting this would change a recipe, not an input contract.

design.folds: the same expanding walk-forward folds 130 used (FOLD_FIRST_VALID_YEAR = 2020)
design.recipe: the shipped production joint member's recipe (125 columns, pl_topk, OOF isotonic over 8 blocks, weight mask 0.5 / seed 20260810, TE on jockey_id+trainer_id smoothing 10), 900 rounds

evaluation_regimes.scarce: validation rows masked to the target rate. For 2026 this masks NOTHING (already at the rate), so 2026 is the only year measured under REAL scarcity; 2020-2025 are a simulation in the sense of 097's pseudo supply-stoppage, and the estimand is the steady state.
evaluation_regimes.natural: validation rows untouched. Real conditions for every year: plentiful for 2020-2025, scarce for 2026.

design.why_scarce_is_primary: Netkeiba does not publish a per-horse first 3F and will not, so every race served from 2026 onward faces the scarce condition permanently while the training set stays mostly pre-cutover. That is the condition the deployed model actually meets, exactly as 091 made the weight-masked serving regime its primary and full information its guard.
design.aggregation: per-race winner-NLL differences (candidate - control), averaged ACROSS SEEDS as losses, never by averaging probabilities

decision_rule.what_is_being_decided: whether this line becomes a candidate worth its own prospective registration - NOT adoption. Every one of the seven years is development period, so no adoption is possible from this measurement however it comes out.
continue_requires_all_of: quality guards on the primary: top2 logloss <= +0.0005, top3 logloss <= +0.0005, win ECE <= +0.001
at least 5 of the 7 years negative in the primary
decision_rule.otherwise: STOP and record. A null closes the axis for this construction; it does not close first-3F as information (097 already measured a replacement column and rejected it separately).

floor_justification.why_this_number: It is 091's delta, and 091 is the same question in the same shape: a column block that is present in training and absent in serving, fixed by masking it during training. Using its bar keeps the two comparable.
floor_justification.why_not_-0.0004: That floor was derived for a different decision - 'does a SECOND mixture member buy more than another seed would' - and it prices 21 extra member-years of maintenance. This intervention adds no members and no maintenance: it changes a recipe, and members are refit at coefficient updates anyway. Importing -0.0004 here would be borrowing a number whose reasoning does not apply.
floor_justification.why_not_higher: delta = 0.00352 from the v4 multiple-testing budget prices a CONFIRMATORY adoption. This measurement cannot adopt - its window is development period - so it is not spending that budget.

prohibitions: No re-choosing the mask rate, the mask unit, or the mask seed.
No dropping or adding years after seeing numbers; all seven are reported.
No switching which regime is primary after seeing numbers.
No selecting a seed by score; all three are reported and averaged as losses.
No reading a subgroup as the verdict.

what_is_already_known.disclosure: The 2-year, single-seed breakpoint is already measured and its numbers are known to the author of this file: 2024 (simulated scarcity) -0.002390 with 98.75% CI [-0.006505, +0.001939]; 2026 (real scarcity) -0.006602 with CI [-0.013597, +0.000504]. Both CIs cross zero.
what_is_already_known.why_this_file_is_still_a_pre-registratio: No 7-year number and no multi-seed number exists for this question. The floor, the regimes, the guards and the year conditions are fixed here before any of them is computed.
what_is_already_known.what_would_have_made_it_illegitimate: Choosing the floor after seeing the 7-year result. The breakpoint numbers do not identify a floor: -0.002 sits between them, so they do not tell the author which side the extension will land on.
what_is_already_known.procedural_note: The breakpoint itself had NO pre-registered numeric continue/stop rule. That was a gap, recorded in research-c-breakpoint.md, and this file exists so it is not repeated.

limits: All seven years are development period (2020-2026-08 was consumed by 129/130/132/134 and the member kill-test). Nothing here can be confirmatory.
The mask matches the RATE, not the PATTERN: real 2026 missingness concentrates on horses whose racing history is post-cutover, and a pseudo-random draw breaks that correlation.
Single fold per year-seed. Re-training variance enters only through the three seeds.
2020-2025 under the scarce regime are simulations; only 2026 is real.
